# FDG9003

> DO increase the visibility of aggregate components by giving them names that correspond to well-known entities of the system, such as `MessageQueue`, `Process`, or `EventLog`.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

Not machine-checkable: whether a name corresponds to a well-known entity of the system is a design judgment. The Cwalina annotation of FDG9001 gives the same advice.
